Welcome to my channel.
I create massage and healing videos, including ASMR, to explore how we can truly heal the body and mind.

I’m a Registered Massage Therapist and former orthopedic doctor from Ukraine. Healing has always been my lifelong passion. Along with my medical background, I’ve studied acupuncture, cupping, and Japanese massage to help people who don’t find relief through conventional treatments.

I hope my videos bring you relaxation, balance, and inspiration to care for yourself.
